profile_text: As a leading fashion retailer in Düsseldorf, Germany, this company has achieved remarkable growth of 366.7% since its baseline, driven by its successful operations in the fashion industry. With a focus on retail, it has expanded its workforce to 56 employees in 2024, solidifying its position as a key player in the market. This rapid expansion has earned it a "Gazelle" category designation, indicating its exceptional growth trajectory.
